candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether participation weakened before, during, or after the reported price declines and rebounds, helping distinguish persistent breadth deterioration from endpoint changes. Existing point-in-time proxy snapshots are not a comparable history.
candidates.evidence_reference: Repeated daily reviews report proxy breadth snapshots with changing membership hashes; weekly reviews identify missing breadth sequences and methodology.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped breadth counts and constituent returns for a consistently defined universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: No comparable prior-days series is supplied to test breadth persistence or its sequence relative to price; single snapshots and changing universes cannot resolve that gap.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether spot participation and liquidity conditions deteriorated ahead of price weakness or merely coincided with it, and whether they persisted through rebounds.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews describe brief, mixed taker and depth snapshots and repeatedly note that historical microstructure sequences are unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped spot taker-flow and depth-imbalance observations for BTC and ETH
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied short snapshots cannot establish persistence, lead-lag ordering, or whether the flow and depth observations changed before or after the price moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would distinguish a single-session mixed flow observation from a sustained sequence and permit comparison of settled flows with the reported price, breadth, and leadership changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews often have only one latest settled ETF session; weekly reviews cite weekly totals but lack time-ordered settled observations.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals with settlement dates
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse session observations and aggregate weekly totals do not reveal within-period flow sequence or persistence, limiting assessment of whether flows supported or diverged from market conditions.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow matured outcomes to be linked to the information available at each frozen warning or forecast timestamp, making premature-versus-late outcome descriptions auditable without treating overlapping observations as independent events.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly report zero eligible prospective typed warning rows, missing candidate-linked outcomes, or absent issue timestamps and outcome rows.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen candidate and warning records linked to timestamped matured metric outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: Counts and cohort medians are not tied to the claims or decision-time snapshots being reviewed; absent links prevent candidate-level outcome assessment and leave hindsight and eligibility boundaries unresolved.
